row_order: orders sorted by order_key; events sorted by (order_key, event_seq)
notes: Documented caps: userFills 'Returns at most 2000 most recent fills'; userFillsByTime 'at most 2000 fills per response and only the 10000 most recent fills are available'. A response of exactly 2000 rows must produce a possible-truncation warning (importer proposal; SPEC silent).

qty_str for fills-only orders: the importer renders the summed size as a normalized decimal string ('0.001' here = 5 x '0.0002'); tests may prefer to compare orig_qty only. SPEC does not define qty_str when the order size is never reported (SPEC gap).
request.json is the POST body that produced the response (not an importer input).
